changes: In /agent/solver.md I added a submit gate with three checks (public examples pass, a random cross-check against an independent brute force has zero mismatches, and max-size timing is acceptable). I also added guidance to avoid submitting enumeration-based solutions on hard problems and to keep using the remaining budget instead. Most failures were submissions made before any cross-check, or with a solution the agent already expected to time out, while the budget was far from exhausted. I ran one trial on lcb-3655, which still failed: the agent again skipped the cross-check, arguing the state space was small. I then strengthened that rule to say a small state space does not replace the independent check. That final wording is untested, and validate() passes.
